creator: Alexander Terp
description: Measured 2026-10-03 (corpus/codex-0.154.0/queue.txt): codex queue --thread <name|id> --message starts a turn in a running TUI session without typing into its pane. A route needs a session-reference capability (a --session-id report from hooks; both Claude Code and Codex hand hooks session_id) and a manifest table for the command (MIP-5 section 10), plus a precedence decision against the doorbell. MIP-5 Open Questions records it.
title: 🧩 Codex: a codex queue route that types nothing
